      "snippet": "You’re looking at a real, mechanically useful test—but in its current form it is also mis-aimed for the bundle you actually have.
What’s “the deal” with that script

It hard-codes an outdated path

Your script assumes: ROOT/deltas/2025-12/*.mips.json

In the mounted v7.6.10R bundle, there is no deltas/2025-12/ directory at the top level. The *.mips.json files exist, but they’re distributed across the bundle (including nested/expanded historical packs).

It treats all *.mips.json as “deltas”
